model.name: R20.7: Drawer is an OVERLAY on top of the overview — position:fixed, not embedded/split.
model.description: STRUCTURAL: the drawer MUST be an OVERLAY LAYER on top of the overview page (position:fixed or absolute, z-index above overview), NOT embedded within the room page or splitting the layout. Supersedes any split-layout approach. Behaviors: (a) drawer floats on top of the overview; (b) items PARTIALLY visible (half-behind the drawer edge) are tappable on their VISIBLE exposed part → tap switches the drawer to that item's detail; (c) tapping ON the drawer overlay affects ONLY the drawer — no pass-through/click-through to the overview beneath; (d) items FULLY covered by the drawer are not tappable (acceptable — user scrolls or resizes drawer to expose them).
model.tronQuote:
> TRON: "the drawer is structurally wrong. its part of the room page and not on top of the overviews page"
> TRON (design): "overlay on top; you can only click an item HALF BEHIND [tap its VISIBLE part → switches]; if you click on the overlay it does NOT affect the overview."
model.crossRefNote: BUG5 (detail switch broken) + BUG4 (deselect closes) were symptoms of the structural error (drawer embedded in room page). R20.7 fixes the structure: overlay on top. Prior split approach is reverted.

intendedChain.useCase: drawer.overlayStructure — drawer is position:fixed overlay on top of overview, not embedded
intendedChain.method: mount as overlay (position:fixed, z-index above overview, pointer-events:auto on drawer only)
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) assert drawer element has position:fixed + z-index > overview. (2) tap item half-visible behind drawer edge → drawer switches to that item. (3) tap drawer body → overview does NOT receive the click (no pass-through). Currently FAILS (drawer is embedded/split in room page).
